name: Sanctuary Key
summary: A mosque forms the bow of a bold key, with its open doorway aligned to the key shaft.
why: The dome, doorway and key shaft share x58. The shaft overlaps the three-unit floor of the mosque by one unit, making a physical connection. The minaret crown meets its shaft and the shaft joins the prayer hall. The key turns welcome into one memorable silhouette.
risk: The key may also suggest access or security; the mosque-shaped bow must remain prominent.
sub2: A metaphor for welcome and access
reasonToChoose: You want a bold mosque identity built around opening and welcome.
